name: @vexa/no-image-backend
description: Stands in for `sharp` in the terminal's npm tree (package.json overrides), so `npm ci` installs no libvips (LGPL, FINOS Category X). next loads sharp only for the image optimizer, which next.config.ts turns off; any call throws a typed ImageBackendAbsent. src/index.cjs is byte-identical to core/meetings/modules/no-image-backend (the parity fact no-image-backend-terminal).
